Traveling with Apple devices usually means bringing along a pile of cables and plug adapters. The RORRY Flow power bank aims to solve this problem by integrating everything you need into one compact charger. It has built-in folding prongs, an integrated USB-C cable, and a magnetic charger designed specifically for the Apple Watch. It's exactly the kind of accessory I love most for travel, handling everything from on-the-go charging to overnight charging.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers breaks down the latest developments in MagSafe and the wireless charging industry, helping you get the most out of your wireless-charging-capable Apple devices.

Built for travel

This RORRY Flow power bank already has built-in folding wall prongs on the back, so you don't need to carry an extra plug to recharge the power bank—just plug it straight into a wall socket at a hotel or vacation rental. It also comes with a built-in USB-C cable (I absolutely love this design!), meaning you don't need to bring a single cable even if you want to charge your iPhone, iPad, Kindle, Switch, and more.

Although I usually focus mainly on MagSafe for iPhone, this power bank features a special 5W magnetic charging module dedicated to charging the Apple Watch. When the Apple Watch is running low on battery, you just place it on top to top it up easily—it's super convenient. It holds the watch securely in place, so you can charge it without bringing the original charger.

This power bank has a 10,000 mAh capacity, more than enough to keep an iPhone and Apple Watch going through a full day of long-distance travel. For me, the most useful thing is that it delivers 40W output via USB-C, which in an emergency is enough to top up a closed-lid MacBook Air.

RORRY Flow power bank summary

If you want to lighten your travel bag for your Apple devices, the RORRY Flow power bank is a solid choice. It combines a wall charger, Apple Watch charging cable and USB-C cable into one, with a minimalist design that fits easily into a bag or pocket.

You can buy this RORRY Flow portable charger directly from RORRY or Amazon.
